newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions 5 bln rupees' six-month bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions 5 bln rupees' six-month bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said it had auctioned six-month short-term federal bonds worth 5.102 billion rupees on Monday at a weighted average yield of 15.38533 percent per annum.
The bank said it recieved bids worth 30.613 billion rupees out of which bids for 5.102 billion rupees were accepted.
In the previous auction held on July 22, bids worth 13.463 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 16.46165 percent per annum.
